name: 14513 · Newark, NY
findings: ZIP 14513 (Newark) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14513 (Newark) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14513 (Newark) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
